title: Hemisphere Partition Functions and Stability Across GLSM Phases
exact_target: In the GLSM setting, is the hemisphere partition function $Z_{D^2}:K_0(D)\to\mathbb C$ a central-charge function for a Bridgeland stability condition on $D$, and for the grade-restriction subcategory $W_n$ are the phase quotient categories $D_{\zeta\gg0}$ and $D_{\zeta\ll0}$ related to $W_n$ by the conjectured commuting equivalences?
